storage.filesystem.rootdirectory.description: Absolute path on disk where Docker image layers and metadata are stored.

storage.delete.enabled.description: Allow deletion of blobs and tags via the API (required for garbage collection).

http.addr.description: IP:port pair the registry server binds to (e.g., '127.0.0.1:5000').

http.tls.enabled.description: Enable TLS (HTTPS). Requires valid cert/key paths below.

http.tls.certificate.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format).

http.tls.key.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format).

http.debug.enabled.description: Enable debug endpoints (pprof, prometheus metrics) — not for production unless carefully secured.

http.debug.addr.description: IP:port for debug/metrics server (separate from main API).

http.debug.pprof.enabled.description: Expose pprof heap/cpu profiles for profiling.

auth.htpasswd.realm.description: Auth realm shown in HTTP 401 responses.

auth.htpasswd.path.description: Path to htpasswd file containing user:password entries.

log.fields.service.description: Service name added to log fields for filtering.

threshold.description: Number of consecutive failures before marking unhealthy.

health.description: List of health checks (e.g., 'disk', 'redis') — keys are check names, values are config objects.
